whatItIs.headline: A shared space for people who make things.
whatItIs.body: ODDspace is a 1,000+ m² shared space in Vallila for people working across art, culture, design, media, business and other creative fields. It combines workspace, studios, meeting rooms, event spaces and a growing community under one roof. It's still a pilot — the people using it help shape what it becomes.

spaces.name: Co-working space
spaces.body: For members working day to day — 24/7 access, shared working areas, WiFi and the everyday basics.

spaces.name: Event & gallery space
spaces.body: A raised, curved floor for exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, shoots, gatherings, performances and showcases.

spaces.name: Auditorium
spaces.body: Tiered seating for talks, screenings, presentations, workshops and smaller events.

spaces.name: Audio & podcast studio
spaces.body: For work that needs more than a desk — recording, streaming and production space with its own backdrop and kit.

community.headline: Different practices. Same roof.
community.body: ODDspace is for people working across art, design, culture, music, media, writing, production, entrepreneurship, technology, research and other creative practices. You don't need to fit one title. Useful things happen because different people and practices share the same place — not automatically, but because the chance is there.

eventEnquiry.headline: Want to organise an event?
eventEnquiry.body: Have an exhibition, workshop, talk, screening, launch, performance, gathering, shoot or another idea you want to make happen here? You don't need to be a member to ask.

vision.headline: A practical attempt at continuity.
vision.body: Finland has no shortage of creative people. What's often missing are the places, continuity and shared infrastructure that let creative work keep developing between individual projects, productions and funding cycles. ODDspace is one practical attempt to create more of that — a physical home, repeated encounters, room for new collaborations, and somewhere things can develop over time. It's a pilot for a bigger question: what kind of permanent infrastructure could Finland build around its creative and cultural fields?

faq.question: What is ODDspace?
faq.answer: A 1,000+ m² shared space in Vallila, Helsinki, combining co-working, studios, meeting rooms, a gallery/event space and an auditorium, used by 40+ members working across creative and cultural fields.

faq.question: Where is ODDspace?
faq.answer: Teollisuuskatu 9D, in Vallila, Helsinki — part of the Sture697 development.

faq.question: How do I become a member?
faq.answer: Apply through the contact form with a note on how you'd like to use the space. Memberships are accepted on a rolling basis as space becomes available during the pilot.

faq.question: What does membership cost?
faq.answer: 150€ per month, one flat rate — no tiers.

faq.question: What's included in membership?
faq.answer: Full, 24/7 access to the co-working space, shared facilities and meeting rooms, plus member rates on the gallery and auditorium.

faq.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
faq.answer: No — it's a flexible monthly membership with no long-term commitment during the pilot phase.

faq.question: Can I visit before joining?
faq.answer: Yes — mention it in your message and we'll set up a time to show you around.

faq.question: Can non-members organise events?
faq.answer: Yes. Renting the gallery or auditorium doesn't require membership — get in touch with what you have in mind.

faq.question: What kinds of events can happen there?
faq.answer: Exhibitions, launches, workshops, talks, screenings, shoots, gatherings, performances and showcases have all happened in the space.

faq.question: What spaces are available?
faq.answer: Co-working space, an event/gallery floor, an auditorium and an audio/podcast studio.

faq.question: How much does event use cost?
faq.answer: Member rates: 200€ for a full day in the 1st floor gallery, 100€ for a half day in the auditorium. Non-member rates are set case by case — get in touch.

faq.question: How do I enquire about an event?
faq.answer: Use the contact form and tell us what you have in mind — you don't need to be a member first.

faq.question: Is ODDspace accessible?
faq.answer: If accessibility is a factor for your visit, get in touch before you come and we'll make sure it works.
